mutants.note: With && the first ask stores undefined+1 = NaN, and NaN || 0 reads 0, so the repeat penalty vanished. New test: a 0>1>2 chain asked twice each must next ask 0 vs 2, seeds 1-3.

Jitter scale 1e-6 vs 1e-7 multiplies the same rand() draws; exact ties break the same way and the pick only changes when two scores differ by under 1e-6 relative, which no user can see in which pair is asked.
